parsed.rationale: All three initializers — `HSBColor.init(hue:saturation:brightness:)` in package `ColorPalette`, and `AccentColor.init(hue:saturation:brightness:)` plus `HSBOffset.init(hue:saturation:brightness:)` in package `Wallpaper` — share an identical signature. None of the participating records carry any restraint markers (is_test, is_mock, is_sample_app, is_codegen are all false). Introducing a protocol `HSBInitializable` with a required `init(hue:saturation:brightness:)` would unify the three types under a common contract, enabling callers to work with any HSB-constructible color type generically. Because `Wallpaper` already depends on (or is a sibling of) `ColorPalette` in the `Shared/` tree, the protocol can live in `ColorPalette` and be adopted by all three types without a new package.
